WRITTEN BY HAND 2026-10-15 from discover run 38666680395, which dumped the whole GetBidsList body (8,105 bytes, lastUpdated 2026-10-15T01:39:18Z; kept as fixtures/bushel-synergy.json), and bushel probe run 38666683015. synergycooperative.com is parked and synergycoop.com/markets/cash.php and synergycoop.o.bushelsites.com/cash-bids load no board (discover run 38666385433); their Bushel portal, https://portal.bushelpowered.com/synergy/cash-bids, does. It answers 20 rows across five locations: Almena Grain, Cameron Grain, Elk Mound Grain, Rice Lake Grain, Ridgeland Grain -- corn and soybeans, "New Crop '26" against ZCZ26/ZSX26 and "Jan '27" against ZCH27/ZSF27. locationId is the UUID the payload carries for "Almena Grain"; the town is the board's own name minus "Grain", and Synergy Community Cooperative holds a Wisconsin warehouse licence at each of these five towns (data/registries.json, registry-wcmd). No Chetek board is posted, though Synergy is licensed there.

PLACE: the centroid of ZIP 54805 (Almena), from the licence row in geocodes/places.json. Town precision; no street address is published that this repository holds.
publicNote: Their publicly posted cash board, read from the same Bushel feed their own customer portal reads. Cash and basis are their own commercial numbers. The futures quote is carried only so a consumer can re-check cash minus basis; it is not redistributed as a price feed.
